text:
anya: quick proposal — new console card: per-token sensitivity heatmap + cache-hit by position and model variant. aim: guide routing to cheaper variants for low-sensitivity prefixes and make cache savings auditable.
pj: +1 but cardinality is scary. how to aggregate?
anya: bucket positions (1,2-8,9-32,33-128,129+) and show percentiles. backend keeps sampled histograms (0.5%) and 60s aggregates per-request for 7 days. counts only, no text.
mike: emit bounded proto per request to avoid explosion, e.g. route, model, buckets[], cache_hits[], tokens, latency_ms. fixed-size event.
elaine: sensitivity score computed offline per promptshape+variant (expected cost vs quality delta). UI surfaces 0-100.
dan: billing needs: (1) what-if slider (route % to fallback) with projected cost/latency; (2) attribution: tenant vs shared prefetch cache savings.
pj: rollout behind feature flag, enable for routes >=500 rps. aggregator writes minute summaries to cost-index. add backpressure metric for Kafka.
mike: infra work: router proto change, router-side sampler, aggregator job, cost-index schema, console chart. prototype via feature-gated shim reuse existing pipeline. est 2 sprints prototype, 1 sprint harden.
anya: security: no raw prompts, TTL 7 days, KMS tagging for Private.
elaine: build small eval harness to compute sensitivity per promptshape. store as sparse table.
dan: reconciliation: hourly job to reconcile sampled buckets with invoiceable tokens; alert if delta >1.5%/day.
pj: ops knobs: reservoir sampling fallback and pause heatmap if pipeline overloaded.
mike: UI: clickable buckets show sample count, mean latency, cache-hit fraction, sensitivity score, variance, and link to reconciliation status.
anya: actions: @pj infra doc + retention policy, @mike prototype shim, @elaine sensitivity docs, I'll mock UX. sync tomorrow 10am?
pj: ack, will draft doc.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: cost-telemetry-proxy v0.3 -> staging (CI #4599)
mike: watching staging logs for schema.
anya: thanks team — small rollout, validate value. :rocket:
